claims.text: The quality of the data is empirically evaluated using sentence-level BLEU scores and model output variance metrics, such as average coefficient of variation.
Translations are controlled for quality through various checks, including manual inspections and perplexity measurements.
The evaluation set is constructed to ensure quality by filtering samples based on sentence length and checking for broken URLs.
